cpos.reason: BNetzA identifies both DE*RLS and DE*RSL as Reload-Solution GmbH. Reload-Solution's official public site confirms that it operates public charging infrastructure but does not publish a numeric charging tariff. Public station directories confirm ad-hoc/direct-payment capability on DE*RSL sites but currently expose the direct price as unknown. Seety shows 0.62 EUR/kWh at some Reload-Solution locations, but under the current Germany V9 evidence policy aggregators are discovery-only and cannot be promoted to station pricing. Connector mix includes AC, DC and HPC, so no network-wide fallback is inferred.
cpos.neededToUnblock: An operator-controlled public direct-payment/QR payload, official Reload-Solution tariff sheet, AFIR/Mobilithek price component, or equivalent primary station/EVSE evidence exposing the exact current numeric tariff.

cpos.reason: The official Stadtwerke Ettlingen price sheet valid from 1 April 2026 provides exact own/public charging components. e-laden account/card charging is 1.00 EUR per session plus 0.40 EUR/kWh AC or 0.45 EUR/kWh DC and 0.03 EUR/min after 180 minutes during 06:00-22:00. Ad-hoc QR/card charging is 1.50 EUR per session plus 0.57 EUR/kWh AC or 0.77 EUR/kWh DC and 0.05 EUR/min after 60 minutes. The current V9 direct-offer runtime has no verified per-session start-fee representation, so encoding only the kWh component would understate total cost. The tariff is therefore recorded as exact-but-deferred rather than flattened.
cpos.neededToUnblock: A validated V9 runtime/schema field for fixed per-session charging fees, followed by contract tests for the time component and the 06:00-22:00 account/card blocking window.

ownerLabelsNotCounted.reason: The certified BNetzA build contains Wasserwerk Vechta charging sites but no recognizable EVSE party prefix on those rows. Under the canonical unique-EVSE-prefix metric it is not a separate one of the 556 CPO prefixes and is therefore not added to the counter.

guardrails: Aggregator prices remain discovery-only and cannot classify a station as priced.
Exact multi-component tariffs are not flattened when the runtime cannot represent all mandatory components.
Blocked prefixes are not re-audited without new primary evidence.
